input: createSolvedCube(2), defaultStickerHex, stickerless=false, no turning layer
instrumentation: generate-raw-mesh.mjs transforms a verified generated module copy only: adds ranges around native body/sticker/cap emission calls in original x/y/z loop. Every typed array is tested byte-for-byte against the uninstrumented function. Node JSON import hook is transport only; the native JSON bytes and source modules are untouched.
rangeContract: Indices are global and contiguous; owner is native x/y/z in 0..1, candidate pID=4*x+2*y+z. Face is native lowercase. Positions are global native coordinates, localize by subtracting owner-[0.5,0.5,0.5]; normals/colors/occlusion are unchanged. Source loops own every primitive; there is no separate global range for this case.
turnOracle: Original source invoked with R depth=1 width=1 at angles 0, pi/4, pi/2; per-attribute SHA-256 covers native typed-array bytes.
shadowSamples: Chromium WebGL, RGBA8 pixels; native fragment source with compile-time loop constants substituted. Renderer reports WebKit WebGL; sample values can vary by GPU precision.
scope: Render data only; no production mechanics, physical identity inference, visual parity or owner acceptance is asserted.
surfaceSamples: Original VS and FS compiled together in Chromium WebGL RGBA8; identity model/MVP, fragment at origin, native camera and key/fill, four normal/color/occlusion inputs. Results can vary by GPU precision.
